system_description.narrative_title: Israel's operations, settler violence and Lebanon spillover
system_description.narrative_summary: Headlines show an intensification of Israeli military operations and settler-driven violence across the West Bank, Gaza and southern Lebanon, with growing civilian harm and displacement. Diplomatic contention centers on tying Israeli withdrawals to Hezbollah disarmament and disputes over which states could verify that disarmament, drawing in the US and regional actors and risking wider regional escalation.
system_description.scope: Geographic: Gaza, West Bank, southern Lebanon and the Israel–Lebanon border; Actors and processes: Israeli security forces, Israeli settlers, Palestinian civilians and armed groups, Hezbollah, the Lebanese state, the US and selected third states; dynamics include military strikes, settler sieges/raids, troop deployments, verification negotiations over Hezbollah disarmament, international diplomatic pressure, and humanitarian impacts (casualties, displacement, aid access).
system_description.super_system: Regional Middle East security architecture and the international diplomatic order (including US policy, Arab states, Iran, UN and international legal/humanitarian regimes).
adjacent_subsystems: Lebanese internal politics, security and prisoner/pardon dynamics
Humanitarian and aid response in Gaza, West Bank and southern Lebanon
Iranian regional influence and proxy networks
evidence_headlines: UK, Italy among states considered to verify Hezbollah disarmament, sources say
Lebanon has not agreed to shortlist of countries that could verify Hezbollah's disarmament, official says
After US criticism, Israel ties Lebanon withdrawal to Hezbollah disarmament
Israel sends troops into West Bank homes besieged by Jewish settlers
Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon kill at least 11

variables.name: Intensity of military operations
variables.description: Measures the frequency and severity of armed strikes, raids and offensive actions by security forces across the area.

variables.name: Intensity of settler-led violence
variables.description: Measures the frequency and severity of attacks, sieges and raids carried out by settler groups against civilian populations.

variables.name: Non-state armed group firepower
variables.description: Measures cumulative weapons, munitions and delivery capabilities held by non-state armed groups in the area.

variables.name: Troop deployment density
variables.description: Measures the concentration of regular security and military personnel deployed in contested or civilian-populated areas.

variables.name: Civilian casualty rate
variables.description: Measures the rate of civilian deaths and injuries per unit time resulting from hostilities and violent incidents.

variables.name: Displaced civilian population
variables.description: Measures the number of civilians who have been uprooted from their homes and remain displaced due to violence or insecurity.

variables.name: Humanitarian access level
variables.description: Measures the degree to which humanitarian actors can reach affected populations and deliver aid, medical care and services.

variables.name: Verification negotiation intensity
variables.description: Measures the pace, intensity and persistence of negotiations and bargaining over disarmament verification arrangements.

variables.name: Perceived trust in potential verifiers
variables.description: Measures parties' confidence in the neutrality, competence and reliability of external actors proposed to verify compliance.

variables.name: External diplomatic pressure
variables.description: Measures the intensity of diplomatic actions, statements, leverage and interventions by outside actors to shape outcomes.

variables.name: Cross-border incident frequency
variables.description: Measures the frequency of armed incidents, strikes or incursions that cross international or de facto borders between neighboring areas.

variables.name: Regional escalation risk perception
variables.description: Measures the perceived likelihood that localized hostilities will expand into a broader regional confrontation.

variables.name: Legal and humanitarian enforcement capacity
variables.description: Measures the effectiveness of legal, judicial and humanitarian mechanisms to investigate abuses, impose accountability and enforce norms.

variables.name: Resource access tension
variables.description: Measures the level of competition, diversion and contestation over essential resources such as water, land and infrastructure.

variables.name: Security force militarization
variables.description: Measures the degree to which policing in civilian areas uses military equipment, powers, tactics and legal authorities.

variables.name: Media and narrative polarization
variables.description: Measures the intensity of polarized information campaigns, propaganda and competing narratives shaping public and elite perceptions.

catalysts.title: Negotiations over shortlist of verifiers for Hezbollah disarmament
catalysts.description: Ongoing talks about which countries could verify Hezbollah's disarmament as Lebanon has not agreed to a shortlist and states (UK, Italy) are being considered.
catalysts.rationale: Lebanon hasn't agreed to shortlist while UK, Italy considered to verify Hezbollah disarmament (headlines 2026-08-13).

catalysts.title: Israel ties withdrawal to Hezbollah disarmament
catalysts.description: Israel conditioning any withdrawal from southern Lebanon on Hezbollah disarmament, likely delaying redeployment and shaping military posture.
catalysts.rationale: After US criticism, Israel ties Lebanon withdrawal to Hezbollah disarmament (headline 2026-08-13).

catalysts.title: Potential Jared Kushner visit to Israel
catalysts.description: A likely high-profile visit (reported as possibly next week) that could influence diplomatic talks and messaging around Gaza and Lebanon.
catalysts.rationale: Report that Jared Kushner may visit Israel next week for talks on Gaza (headline 2026-08-14).

catalysts.title: Wave of settler sieges and clashes in West Bank
catalysts.description: Ongoing sieges of Palestinian homes by settlers, repeated clashes involving Israeli troops, and village lockdowns are likely to persist and intensify local violence.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines report settlers besieging homes, sieges in Qusra, troops clashing with settlers and village lockdowns (2026-08-13 to 2026-08-14).

catalysts.title: Expansion of police powers in occupied West Bank
catalysts.description: Israeli move to grant police powers in the occupied West Bank will change law-enforcement posture and likely increase militarized policing.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Israel moves to give police powers in occupied West Bank' (2026-08-15).

catalysts.title: Continuation/escalation of strikes in southern Lebanon
catalysts.description: Recent deadly Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon are likely to continue, driving cross-border hostilities and humanitarian impacts.
catalysts.rationale: Multiple headlines report Israeli strikes killing 11 and 7 in south Lebanon (2026-08-15) and campaign making southern Lebanon 'unliveable' (2026-08-13/14).

catalysts.title: Lebanon's planned mass prisoner release
catalysts.description: A controversial amnesty and planned mass release of prisoners in Lebanon could affect militant manpower and political dynamics.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Lebanon set for mass prisoner release after controversial amnesty' (2026-08-15).

catalysts.title: US pressure for Israeli condemnation of settler sieges
catalysts.description: US calls for Israeli leaders to condemn settler sieges could produce short-term diplomatic leverage and affect Israeli messaging and enforcement.
catalysts.rationale: US wants Netanyahu to condemn settler siege in Palestinian village (headline 2026-08-14).
